title: Simulation of Sequential Statements
statement: Let $S$ be a program setting. Suppose the first statement $s_1$ executes from $\sigma$ to $\sigma_1$ in $c_1$ steps, and both $s_1$ from $\sigma$ to $\sigma_1$ in $c_1$ steps and $s_2$ from $\sigma_1$ to $\sigma_2$ in $c_2$ steps simulate their executions. Then the sequence of $s_1$ followed by $s_2$ simulates execution from $\sigma$ to $\sigma_2$ in $c_1+c_2$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: The first statement executes from $\sigma$ to $\sigma_1$ in $c_1$ steps.
The first statement simulates from $\sigma$ to $\sigma_1$ in $c_1$ steps.
The second statement simulates from $\sigma_1$ to $\sigma_2$ in $c_2$ steps.
